main_result.name: QFORM-TRANSLATED-FRESH-SQUARE-SIGNFREE-v1
main_result.statement_short: If X,Z,W are mutually independent, H,U are arbitrary functions of W, G=G(X,W) is arbitrary, Y=gamma X+H and V=sigma Z+G, then for any invertible symmetric 3x3 B with b=B33 nonzero, Q=(Y,U,V)^T B(Y,U,V)+affine has ||p_Q||_inf <= 2^(13/4)(L_Z/|sigma|) sqrt(L_X L_U/|gamma|)(|b det B|)^(-1/4), assuming density caps L_X,L_Z,L_U.
main_result.mechanism: Condition on X,W and complete the square in V. The shared shift G disappears exactly from the Schur residual; only the genuine fresh innovation sigma Z is paid. Then use the sign-free root-collar/absolute-quadratic-band integration in Y,U. No conditional projection-height supremum or projected independence is used.

target_family.definition: On one common leaf product bank take orthonormal projections L,U,P; with fresh X0,Z0 let Y=X0+eta L, V=Z0+epsilon P and Q_a=4[aY^2+2YU+V^2]. Add independent 4R^2 for the all-a strict target family.
target_family.density_bound: ||p_Qa||_inf<=2sqrt(2) for all real a,eta,epsilon; the independent 4R^2 extension keeps the same bound.
target_family.spectral_check: In normalized carrier coordinates the extension has matrix 4[[a s^2,s,0,0],[s,0,0,0],[0,0,t^2,0],[0,0,0,1]], s^2=1+eta^2, t^2=1+epsilon^2. Eigenvalues 4t^2 and 4 are >=4; the hyperbolic 2x2 block has one eigenvalue of modulus at least 4s>=4, so at least three eigenvalues are always large.

corrections_preserved: A bounded joint projection density alone is not inserted into an arbitrary indefinite level-set integral.
No normalized conditional projection-height or worst-fiber shortcut.
Small coefficients multiplying unbounded random variables are not deleted.
The observed translated square may share the light bank; the proof pays only the genuine independent innovation before nonlinear integration.
